description: Filesystem access is granted at runtime for the one folder the user picks, so no path scope is listed here. These entries widen WHICH fs commands the webview may call; WHERE it may call them is still gated by allow_vault in lib.rs. Every call in src/storage/tauriStorage.ts needs a grant here — a missing one fails ONLY in a Tauri build, never in the browser, which is how read-file and remove shipped broken in v0.1.0.
